numbers.romanized: ek ane be maline tran thay chhe.

numbers.nativeScript: અમે છ રંગો જોઈ રહ્યા છીએ.
numbers.romanized: ame chha rango joi rahya chhiye.
numbers.english: We are looking at six colors.
I need to arrange eight papers.

numbers.nativeScript: એક ગોળક જમીન પર પડ્યું છે.
numbers.romanized: ek golak jameen par padyu chhe.
numbers.english: One ball is lying on the ground.
Two lamps are near the window.
Four cups are on the table.

numbers.nativeScript: પાંચ બાળકો મેદાનમાં દોડી રહ્યા છે.
numbers.romanized: paanch baalakoon medanma dodi rahya chhe.
numbers.english: Five children are running in the field.

numbers.romanized: chha machhlio paani ma tarati chhe.
numbers.english: Six fish are swimming in the water.

numbers.romanized: saat phoolo baag ma khilya chhe.
numbers.english: Seven flowers have bloomed in the garden.

numbers.nativeScript: આઠ ગ્લાસ શેલ્ફ પર રાખ્યા છે.
numbers.romanized: aath glaas shelf par rakhya chhe.
numbers.english: Eight glasses are kept on the shelf.

numbers.nativeScript: નવ તારાઓ આકાશમાં ચમકી રહ્યા છે.
numbers.romanized: nav tarao aakashma chamki rahya chhe.
numbers.english: Nine stars are shining in the sky.
